refine - the Landin bootstrap compiler
use refine version for build identity
language frontend: scanner, parser, names, types, definite assignment
target-neutral IR: lowered and verified
backends: linux-x86-64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64, freebsd-x86-64, freebsd-arm64, linux-rv64, cortex-m0, rv32 and xtensa assembly
executable output: assembled and linked by a target-selected native toolchain
targets described: linux-x86-64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64, freebsd-x86-64, freebsd-arm64, linux-rv64, cortex-m0, rv32, synthetic-32, xtensa
levels of linux-x86-64: x86-64-v1, x86-64-v2, x86-64-v3, x86-64-v4
levels of linux-arm64: armv8-a, armv8.1-a
levels of darwin-arm64: armv8-a, armv8.1-a
levels of freebsd-x86-64: x86-64-v1, x86-64-v2, x86-64-v3, x86-64-v4
levels of freebsd-arm64: armv8-a, armv8.1-a
levels of linux-rv64: rv64gc, rv64gc_zba, rv64gc_xtheadba, rv64gc_zba_xtheadba
levels of cortex-m0: armv6-m, armv7-m, armv7e-m, armv8-m.main
levels of rv32: rv32imc, rv32imac
levels of xtensa: xtensa-esp32, xtensa-esp32s3
